## Getting started

Climate change and sustainable development have become the topics of debate in recent years. Countries use different policies to identify and target respective ecological challenges. It is important to admit that geographical location, development level and reliance on resources have different effects on green transition efforts. In this blog we will explore how countries' sustainability levels have changed since 1990, what regions share ecological indicators, and what policies are key to improve the environment in these places.

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 650

#Load the libraries inside the standalone chunk
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(viridis)

#URL to the RDS file
co2_map_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/
acstat231-s25/blog-econ/main/Data/co2_map.rds"

temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
download.file(co2_map_url, temp_file, mode = "wb")
#Read the downloaded RDS file and load into the system.
co2_map <- readRDS(temp_file)
#User Interface
ui <- fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("year", "Select Year:",
                  #Allow the user to choose a year between 1994 and 2022 
                  min = 1994, max = 2022, value = 1991,
                  step = 1, sep = "", 
                  # Allow the user to animate graph
                  animate = animationOptions(interval = 1000))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("mapPlot", height = "600px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  filtered <- reactive(co2_map %>% filter(Year == input$year))
  output$mapPlot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(filtered()) +
      geom_sf(aes(geometry = geometry, fill = co2conc),
              colour = "grey40", linewidth = .2) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", na.value = "grey90",
                           name = "% change vs 1990") +
      coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin", expand = FALSE) +
      theme_void(base_size = 16) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
      labs(title = paste0("CO₂ emissions relative to 1990: ", input$year))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```

## Research questions and motivation

1. For policymakers to create efficient sustainability policies that mitigate climate change, it may be helpful to know which countries are performing on similar levels or exhibiting similar demographic trends and characteristics. Which countries perform similarly for key sustainability indicators, such as renewable energy consumption, electricity production from oil/coal, or renewable energy sources?
2. Deforestation and massive population growth are two examples of major problems contributing to climate change, yet they disproportionately affect some countries. To what degree do certain sustainability indicators impact countries differently?
3. Considering data from at least two periods, how likely is a country to advance to a more sustainable cluster based on its indicator values?

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

plot_indicator <- function(indicator_name) {
  data1 <- data |>
    filter(`Indicator Name` == indicator_name) |>
    select(region_un, starts_with(c("19", "20")), ends_with("_median")) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with(c("19", "20")) & ends_with("_median"),
      names_to = "period",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    mutate(period = as.integer(str_remove(period, "_median")))
  
ggplot(data1, aes(x = period, y = value, color = region_un)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = paste(indicator_name),
      subtitle = "Median values per year",
      x = "Year",
      y = indicator_name,
      color = "Region"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

indicators <- c(
  "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)", 
  "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
  "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)",
  "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
  "Population growth (annual %)", 
  "Forest area (% of land area)",
  "Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions (total) excluding LULUCF (% change from 1990)"
)

for (indicator in indicators) {
  print(plot_indicator(indicator))
}

```

# Appendix

``` {r}
#| label: kmeans-clustering

climate1 <- read.csv("raw-data/climate-change.csv", skip = 3)
climate1 <- climate1 |>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)|>
  select(-"Indicator Code") 

# vector for selected variables of interest
sustain_indicators <- c(
  "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
  "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
  "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)",
  "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)")

# setting up first period data frame (year 1990)
sustainability1990 <- climate1 |>
    filter(`Indicator Name` %in% sustain_indicators) |>
    select(`Country Name`, `Country Code`, `Indicator Name`, `1990`) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Indicator Name`, 
                values_from = `1990`) |>
    drop_na()

# setting up second period data frame (year 2015)
sustainability2015 <- climate1 |>
    filter(`Indicator Name` %in% sustain_indicators) |>
    select(`Country Name`, `Country Code`, `Indicator Name`, `2015`) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = `Indicator Name`, 
                values_from = `2015`) |>
    drop_na()

# standardize the indicator values for 1990
sustain_1990_std <- sustainability1990 |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric)
                , ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x)
                , .names = "{.col}_z")) |>
  select(ends_with("_z"))

# standardize the indicator values for 2015
sustain_2015_std <- sustainability2015 |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric)
                , ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x)
                , .names = "{.col}_z")) |>
  select(ends_with("_z"))

# run k-means clustering
set.seed(231)

# first, elbow plots for each year's standardized data
elbow_1990 <- tibble(k = 1:10) |>
  mutate(
    kmeans_results = map(k, ~kmeans(sustain_1990_std, .x, nstart = 20)),
    glanced = map(kmeans_results, glance)
  ) |>
  unnest(cols = c(glanced))
elbow_2015 <- tibble(k = 1:10) |>
  mutate(
    kmeans_results = map(k, ~kmeans(sustain_2015_std, .x, nstart = 20)),
    glanced = map(kmeans_results, glance)
  ) |>
  unnest(cols = c(glanced))

ggplot(elbow_1990, aes(x = k, y = tot.withinss)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot for 1990 Sustainability Data",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)", 
       y = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(elbow_2015, aes(x = k, y = tot.withinss)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot for 2015 Sustainability Data",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)", 
       y = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()

# based on the elbow plot, k = 4
sustain_1990_kmeans4 <- sustain_1990_std |>
  kmeans(centers = 4, nstart = 20)
sustain_2015_kmeans4 <- sustain_2015_std |>
  kmeans(centers = 4, nstart = 20)

sustain_1990_c4 <- augment(sustain_1990_kmeans4, sustainability1990) |>
  rename(cluster_1990 = .cluster)
sustain_2015_c4 <- augment(sustain_2015_kmeans4, sustainability2015) |>
  rename(cluster_2015 = .cluster)

# comparing clusters
clusters_1990 <- sustain_1990_c4 |>
  select(`Country Name`, cluster_1990)
clusters_2015 <- sustain_2015_c4 |>
  select(`Country Name`, cluster_2015)

cluster_comparison <- clusters_1990 |>
  inner_join(clusters_2015, by = "Country Name")
cluster_comparison

# visualization choice: scatterplot matrix
# for standardized 1990 cluster data
sustain_1990_c4 |>
  rename (
      renew_energy_consume = "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
      renew_electric_output = "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
      electric_prod_oil = "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)", 
      electric_prod_coal = "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)"
    ) |>
  select(`renew_energy_consume`, `renew_electric_output`, `electric_prod_oil`, 
         `electric_prod_coal`, `cluster_1990`) |>
  ggpairs(aes(color = cluster_1990)
        , upper = list(continuous = "blank")
        , progress = FALSE) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

# for standardized 2015 cluster data
sustain_2015_c4 |>
  rename (
      renew_energy_consume = "Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)",
      renew_electric_output = "Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)",
      electric_prod_oil = "Electricity production from oil sources (% of total)", 
      electric_prod_coal = "Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)"
    ) |>
  select(`renew_energy_consume`, `renew_electric_output`, `electric_prod_oil`, 
         `electric_prod_coal`, `cluster_2015`) |>
  ggpairs(aes(color = cluster_2015)
        , upper = list(continuous = "blank")
        , progress = FALSE) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))

```
